content:
## Situation

Virtual Compute — A customer requests the maximum permitted immediate payout on the latest paid primary source line, with a lower reviewed target and a resulting account surplus. The terminal state is one permitted payout with any surplus retained on the same account.

## Ordered action 1

1. The agent records the arithmetic review using review_compute_line_e30849b6. Every physical export and original source charge already exists; the desk completes this arithmetic review synchronously.

## Ordered action 2

2. The agent posts the correction credit using credit_compute_line_adb33dcc. The preceding review provides the approved incorrect target; this call immediately posts the correction.

## Ordered action 3

3. The customer themselves files the maximum-permitted refund consent using authorize_compute_refund_4fb241f0. The original payment and preceding posted credit exist; current customer input files pending consent synchronously, with no external review or approval.

## Ordered action 4

4. The agent records the immediate permitted cash refund using refund_compute_payment_f0565a85. The pending customer-filed consent from the preceding call is sufficient authorization, and the completed original payment preexists the conversation; this call records the immediate disposition.

## Reference handovers

The correction uses the preceding review reference as related evidence. The consent uses the preceding posted correction reference as related evidence, while its evidence and original source references both identify the original posted payment. The final refund uses the exact customer request reference supplied by that consent.

## Ordering basis

Review before correction: the approved arithmetic net is the settlement concession basis; swapping them changes the credit and lacks an approved incorrect review. Correction before consent: the customer consents to disposal of the surplus created by the specific posted correction and the consent records that credit reference. Consent before refund: the refund carries the exact customer authorization. All three preceding effects complete synchronously; the original remittance and export already exist at the opening.

## Immediate execution

The export and original completed payment preexist the conversation. The arithmetic review and correction post synchronously; the customer files the pending refund request in person, which itself supplies sufficient consent without a separate approval. The final refund records immediate disposition against that original payment, so no later outside event is a prerequisite.

## Hypothetical case

An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api. Without that combination the signed amendment is submitted through portal or api. A promotional primary-price entitlement is suppressed wherever a commitment price covers the same quantity, and no benefit from an unrelated category is stacked.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: A current Northbridge Enterprise Support holding for the same customer and billing entity provides assisted invoice explanation, but does not itself reduce this category price or waive debt.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: The combination changes only request-channel eligibility, not approval authority.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? An approved negotiated rate is a contract-specific override; the presence of a paid support holding makes assisted negotiated-amendment intake available through support as well as portal and api.

title: Object Storage: correction
content:
Object Storage correction is governed by the following clauses.

For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values. Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review net amount plus tax amount, following tax calculation basis. Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison. A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction. An upward correction carries positive amount. Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved. No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction. Link original source reference to the original charge and supporting evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines. Use net cumulative gross correction magnitude from exact-source credit totals for the correction comparison; prior pretax service concession magnitude never changes the approved corrected billing target.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

For approved correction, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, supporting evidence reference, status, decision. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with original source reference together with supporting evidence reference for the proposed action. For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the current handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report net cumulative gross correction magnitude as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and prior pretax service concession magnitude as absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in net cumulative gross correction magnitude, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? For source business subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

## Hypothetical source separation

Assume a service concession and a correction concern the same invoice line. The concession contributes to the pretax service-credit component but does not change the corrected billing target or enter the gross correction comparison.

title: Object Storage: fees
content:
Object Storage fees is governed by the following clauses.

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and return fee source business subtype. Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return. An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as its termination liability. Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence. A zero fee is waived without a financial event. The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention, then taxed under tax calculation basis. The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing basis and its posted primary source meter gate apply only to source business subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy. Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and return fee source business subtype.

title: Object Storage: incident
content:
Object Storage incident is governed by the following clauses.

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external business reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report. No customer statement substitutes for the report. Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit basis excludes them. Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external business reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration hours and availability percent from the official operational report.

title: Object Storage: invoice
content:
Object Storage invoice is governed by the following clauses.

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. Group service charges by invoice grouping. Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month. For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records. Set invoice issue time to the current handling time. Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge. A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge. The fixed source reference and source business subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

For unbilled source component, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, meter code, source business subtype, effective price branch, period, event type, status. The evidence must correlate original source reference for the proposed action. No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

title: Object Storage: meter
content:
Object Storage meter is governed by the following clauses.

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. Meters originate in the provider resource export. Primary meter quantities use usage unit; a meter is positive and a meter reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed. Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference. billing actual usage overage permits measured quantities above included monthly primary quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write. Round measured quantities to the tier meter quantity precision using the tier rounding convention, apply minimum quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter quantum. Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental meter. A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter. Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.

For export evidence, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, external business reference, service interval start, service interval end, quantity. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

title: Object Storage: pricing
content:
Object Storage pricing is governed by the following clauses.

This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source business subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category meter pricing basis take priority. For source business subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values. Use the tier recorded for each source service interval. Read standard primary unit rate and region factors for primary usage. Allocate included monthly primary quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in service interval start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month. Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged. Allocate committed monthly primary quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines. The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive reservation discounts; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary. For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in discount priority: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated rate allowed, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from promotion channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard. The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard primary unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount. Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive. Round the final service subtotal using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply tax calculation basis. No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits. Record effective price branch for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity. Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

For posted primary source meter, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, status, service interval start, service interval end. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. For source business subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source business subtype values.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source business subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category meter pricing basis take priority.

## Hypothetical price selection

Assume an approved permitted negotiated price and a promotion both cover the same primary quantity. The negotiated price replaces the standard primary rate before the region adjustment, and the promotion contributes no additional discount to that quantity.

title: Object Storage: refund
content:
Object Storage refund is governed by the following clauses.

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment. A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced. Use refund methods, require at least refund minimum, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out. A smaller positive balance remains on account. Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure. Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund. A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

For refund consent, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, customer request reference, original source reference, status, storage contract reference. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with customer request reference together with original source reference together with storage contract reference for the proposed action. The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

## Hypothetical authorization boundary

Assume the applicable refund limit is a hypothetical USD 42. An exact request for USD 43 is refused; it is not converted to a USD 42 payout.

title: Object Storage: request
content:
Object Storage request is governed by the following clauses.

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request. Preserve the exact external business reference and the narrowest original source reference. An unsupported channel is refused. A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event. Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Set notice filing time and recorded occurrence time to the current handling clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

title: Object Storage: return
content:
Object Storage return is governed by the following clauses.

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The bank return must identify the exact posted payment. Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned. Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency. A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external business reference. A duplicate bank notice produces no new write. Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.

For bank return, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, status, external business reference. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with original source reference for the proposed action. The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

title: Object Storage: review
content:
Object Storage review is governed by the following clauses.

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record. Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows. A rejected review cannot authorize money movement. The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision. Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through supporting evidence reference. Review alone books no money.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Record corrected net amount and tax amount for incorrect billing, or claimed or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit basis.

For reviewable source, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, supporting evidence reference, storage contract reference. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference together with original source reference together with supporting evidence reference together with storage contract reference for the proposed action. The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

title: Object Storage: service concession
content:
Object Storage service concession is governed by the following clauses.

For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request. For a service concession request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes. For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its notice filing time; the request is recorded immediately. Later review and credit use that recorded notice filing time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review. Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods. Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit. The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions. Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit. Below the target choose the first descending descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percent. Floor the additional credit at zero and round with the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention. Apply the original tax component proportionately. A review writes its nonnegative approved result; a financial credit writes the negative approved amount only after that approved review exists. This service-credit branch applies only to source business subtype service concession; billing correction basis applies only to source business subtype correction. Excluded incidents, ineligible reviews and zero remaining entitlement result in no financial write. A request for consequential-loss compensation is not covered. A service-credit financial posting requires an approved review with decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount; the request and incident alone cannot authorize the financial posting.

The following former handling clause is **no longer in force**: Multiply the original source charge net amount by that fraction; subtract the prior pretax service concession magnitude component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at cumulative outage credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

For claim deadline, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, official incident closure time, notice filing time. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. For a service concession request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes.

For approved service credit, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, original source reference, status, decision, claimed or approved credit amount. The evidence must correlate original source reference for the proposed action. For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? For a service concession financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive claimed or approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

## Hypothetical filing boundary

Assume an otherwise qualifying claim. A filing at the incident closure time advanced by the tier claim period in UTC calendar dates is timely. A filing immediately after that boundary is late. Reviewing a timely recorded claim after the boundary does not change its original timely filing.

title: Object Storage: tax
content:
Object Storage tax is governed by the following clauses.

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and tax rates. Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using the tier monetary precision and the tier rounding convention. For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment. Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount. Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt. Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount. A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

For tax evidence, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, tax review status, tax treatment. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

## Hypothetical tax example

Assume a final rounded service amount of USD 17.25 and an applicable hypothetical tax fraction of 0.08. Multiplication yields USD 1.38 tax; the gross financial amount is USD 18.63. The tax acts on the rounded service amount.

title: Object Storage: exit
content:
Object Storage exit is governed by the following clauses.

The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract. Only the customer may withdraw an application or terminate their provisioned resources. An applied contract can be withdrawn without any setup, usage or termination charge. For active or suspended contracts, record closed date from the current handling clock and stop running primary meters at the exact customer-confirmed close time. Accrued usage and actual retained-resource charges remain payable; closing never erases receivables or credits. termination fee applies to an on-demand exit under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis. If a signed commitment remains unexpired and commitment cancel allowed is false, invoice its recorded remaining commitment liability in USD as a distinct termination component, without also charging future usage against that same liability. No new usage begins after closure; existing financial corrections, collection and refunds remain possible. Repeating the same closed-resource confirmation has no further effect. Before closing, the signed termination schedule supplies remaining commitment liability in USD and is zero when no unbilled commitment liability remains. A positive recorded liability necessarily triggers the distinct termination charge using the disposal request as its original source reference; closure and that one invoice entry complete the event chain.

For customer disposal, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, customer request reference, original source reference. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference together with customer request reference together with original source reference for the proposed action. The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The customer has filed the exact resource-disposal authorization for this contract.

title: Object Storage: resumption
content:
Object Storage resumption is governed by the following clauses.

The contract status is suspended. The contract official payment restriction state is clear. Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance. Set status active. Bill resumption fee under lifecycle and bank-return fee basis only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history. A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

For contract state, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract status is suspended.

For restriction cleared, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, official payment restriction state. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract official payment restriction state is clear.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The contract status is suspended.

title: Object Storage: suspension
content:
Object Storage suspension is governed by the following clauses.

The contract status is active. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The contract official payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation. Equality qualifies. The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension. Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change. An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction state is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service. Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage. Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

For contract state, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, status. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference for the proposed action. The contract status is active.

For collection deadline, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage business event reference, invoice issue time. The evidence must correlate storage business event reference for the proposed action. Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued.

For collection restriction, the pre-action authority is the system record, using storage contract reference, official payment restriction state, storage business event reference, amount. The evidence must correlate storage contract reference together with storage business event reference for the proposed action. The contract official payment restriction state is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

## Basis Q&A

What is the applicable opening condition? The contract status is active.

## Hypothetical boundary cases

Assume the source invoice still has unpaid principal, the contract is active, and the official restriction is recorded. At the deadline obtained by adding the invoice due period and then the collection grace period to the invoice issue time, suspension qualifies. Immediately before that deadline, handling gives an informational explanation and leaves status unchanged.

title: Object Storage: capacity entitlement handling

title: Object Storage: cool credit handling

The approved assessment is the basis of the financial concession; an unapproved result supplies no money authority. The concession must be posted before its resulting cash balance can be authorized. title: Enterprise Support: Activation evidence
content:

## Policy clauses

The contract status is applied.

The contract approval status is approved.

Activate an approved application after provisioning evidence confirms the configured resources; record activation time from the current handling time.

Refuse rejected or pending applications.

Setup is invoiced under lifecycle fee accounting when setup fee is positive; a waived setup fee creates no charge.

Repeating an activation of an already active contract is a read-only confirmation, not another activation.



### Contract state evidence

The contract status is applied. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

### Provisioning approval evidence

The contract approval status is approved. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, approval status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Signed application admission
content:
Enterprise Support — Signed application admission.

## Policy clauses

The signed application request has an approved service review.

The customer signs and submits the application through an authorized channels channel.

Create status applied and opening date from the current handling time, with no consumption or charge.

The requested tier supplies max resources; reject unsupported regions, unsupported currency, resource counts above that limit, and unapproved contract terms without a write.

The customer owns the signature; an agent cannot sign for them.

Entry gates are evaluated against the authoritative signed application fields copied into the proposed holding.



### Signed approval evidence

The signed application request has an approved service review. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, request reference, status, decision. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, request reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Independent signed resource scopes
content:
Enterprise Support — Independent signed resource scopes.

## Policy clauses

The signed resource scope is not already represented by a nonclosed contract.

Multiple independent resource scopes may be held.

Use external reference as the signed resource-scope key.

Count all nonclosed holdings of this category for the same customer; refuse creation if the count would exceed maximum simultaneous contracts per customer of 24.

A repeated signed application with the same external resource scope reuses the existing contract rather than opening another.

title: Enterprise Support: Corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — corrected-fee assessment.

title: Enterprise Support: Supplemental baseline export hours for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Supplemental baseline export hours for corrected-fee assessment.

For corrected-fee assessment: Sum completed supplemental support spending export quantity, in vCPU-hours, for the same original charge and period; primary missing-export records and rejected records do not enter this baseline. 

### Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.

title: Enterprise Support: Compute campaign selection for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute campaign selection for corrected-fee assessment.

For corrected-fee assessment: For these on-demand compute export reconstructions, an approved negotiated rate receives no further discount; otherwise an eligible compute promotion reduces the compute price by that compute tier promotion discount, and an absent or expired promotion gives zero discount. 

### Points of judgment

For corrected-fee assessment: A negotiated compute price receives no campaign reduction. Without an approved negotiated price, an eligible compute campaign supplies its tier reduction; an absent or expired campaign supplies zero.

title: Enterprise Support: Compute contract price evidence for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Compute contract price evidence for corrected-fee assessment.

For corrected-fee assessment: Select the same-customer active compute contract with the same legal billing entity; use its authorized signed negotiated unit rate, otherwise its tier standard primary unit rate. If there is no matching compute contract, the reconstructed compute rate is zero and no compute-spend contribution is recognized. For corrected-fee assessment: This reconstruction values actual exported compute usage; it does not grant a support discount.

### Points of judgment

For corrected-fee assessment: An authorized negotiated price on the matching active compute contract supplies the selected price; otherwise the selected price comes from that contract’s tier. The matching contract belongs to the same customer and legal billing entity.

title: Enterprise Support: Handling conditions for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Entry conditions for corrected-fee assessment.

For corrected-fee assessment: Before completing the corrected support-fee review, the missing compute-spend export for its original source charge must have a posted primary support meter.

title: Enterprise Support: Discounted charge and minimum order for corrected-charge assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Discounted charge and minimum order for corrected-charge assessment.

For corrected-charge assessment: Multiply eligible spending by the support charge fraction and then by one minus the single support discount; apply the full-month minimum to that discounted subtotal. 

### Hypothetical case

For corrected-charge assessment: Suppose eligible spending is hypothetically USD 1000, the support fraction is 20 percent, the selected discount is 25 percent, and the monthly minimum is USD 175. The percentage subtotal is USD 200, the discounted subtotal is USD 150, and the charge floor yields USD 175. Applying the discount to the minimum instead would not follow this rule.

title: Enterprise Support: Effective compute unit price for corrected-fee assessment
content:
Enterprise Support — Effective compute unit price for corrected-fee assessment.

For corrected-fee assessment: Multiply the selected compute unit price once by one minus its applicable compute discount to obtain the effective cloud rate; all source intervals in this reconciliation use US East and on-demand standard configuration. 

### Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: A hypothetical selected compute unit price of USD 0.80 and applicable discount of 25 percent yield an effective price of USD 0.60 per vCPU-hour. The reduction acts once on the selected unit price.

title: Enterprise Support: Disjoint export spending addition for corrected-fee assessment
content:

For corrected-fee assessment: Add the posted recognized eligible supported spending in USD amount to baseline vCPU-hours multiplied by the effective cloud rate; these are disjoint provider export buckets. 

### Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: Suppose recognized spending is hypothetically USD 70 and the disjoint baseline has 100 vCPU-hours at an effective cloud rate of USD 0.40. Baseline spending is USD 40 and eligible spending is USD 110. The recognized USD 70 is already monetary and is not multiplied by the cloud rate again.

### Hypothetical case

For corrected-fee assessment: A hypothetical reviewed net fee of USD 123.455 rounds half up to USD 123.46. The reviewed tax is zero.

title: Enterprise Support: Support service and ancillary meters
content:
Enterprise Support — Support service and ancillary meters.

## Policy clauses

The selected reference monthly supported-spend band is the plan reference, not an included monetary credit.

Primary eligible supported spending in USD quantity is eligible pre-tax cloud service spending net of correction credits, grouped by legal billing entity and month; service-credit concessions, support fees, taxes and cash remittances are excluded.

marketplace included decides whether marketplace lines enter that base.

Charge the greater of minimum monthly support fee and eligible eligible supported spending in USD times the effective standard primary unit rate after the ordinary non-stacked discount selection, prorating the minimum by actual active seconds in the UTC month for partial-month service.

An approved annual support-spend commitment uses reservation discounts for its covered spend; a promotion, portfolio discount or negotiated percentage instead follows primary usage pricing priority.

No discount reduces the minimum monthly support fee, which remains the last floor applied to the monthly net fee.

The source commitment is a signed support-spend obligation, never an infrastructure reservation borrowed from a different category.

named contacts bills contacts above included contacts at additional contact fee per contact-month.

architecture reviews bills completed reviews above included reviews at extra review fee.

onsite days bills authorized delivered consultant-days at onsite day fee.

Record measured first-response times against critical response minutes, high response minutes and normal response hours using incident-created UTC time to first human response elapsed time; these are service targets, not extra usage fees.

dedicated manager controls whether a named technical account manager can be assigned; without entitlement the assignment is refused and there is no substitute charge.

Service records records these entitlements and actual delivery, never an invented cash credit for a missed response.

For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under service tax accounting.

An allowance is consumed chronologically by inclusive service start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation.

Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply.

Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside the covered policy instead of guessed prices.

These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action.

For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity.

Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice.

A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.



### Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical monthly percentage calculation yields USD 80 and its applicable prorated minimum is USD 100. The net fee is USD 100; the minimum is not an additional USD 100 charge. A hypothetical percentage result of USD 130 remains USD 130.

title: Enterprise Support: Bank-confirmed payment allocation
content:
Enterprise Support — Bank-confirmed payment allocation.

## Policy clauses

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed.

Record only a bank-confirmed remittance using a payment methods rail and the amount actually received in currency.

Customer consent to dispose of funds belongs to the customer; the agent only allocates a payment already confirmed by the bank.

Apply an explicitly referenced invoice first; if the remittance omits allocation, use collection order, sorting invoice issue time then original source reference within the same customer and billing entity.

Split across exact source invoice lines, never across legal billing entities.

Each allocation is a separate negative payment amount linked to its original charge; any residual is an unallocated overpayment linked to the remittance reference.

A repeated remittance reference and allocation target returns the existing posting.

No receipt is inferred from a customer promise, and rejected or pending payments make no posting.



### Confirmed payment evidence

The bank record confirms the remittance as completed. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, status, external reference, method. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

### Measurement basis

All posted financial events through the current handling time. Sum signed amount for charge, debit adjustment, payment return and refund together with negative amount for payment and credit, grouped by holding.

content:
Enterprise Support — Assisted amendment intake.

A same-customer active Northbridge Virtual Compute contract makes assisted support-plan amendment intake available through support; without it the signed amendment is submitted through portal or api.

title: Enterprise Support: Source-line invoice corrections
content:
Enterprise Support — Source-line invoice corrections.

## Policy clauses

For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect.

This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values.

Correct an erroneous charge to the approved review pretax net amount plus signed tax amount, following service tax accounting.

Compare that corrected gross amount with the source original gross amount less cumulative correction credits plus cumulative debit adjustments; do not include service-credit concessions in this correction comparison.

Credit the positive overcharge, debit the positive undercharge, and make no write when equal.

A credit amount is negative and its net and tax components preserve the source proportions except an approved tax correction.

An upward correction carries positive amount.

Return the existing adjustment when the reviewed target has already been achieved.

No cash refund is implicit in an invoice correction.

Link original source reference to the original charge and related evidence reference to the approved review, never to a broad invoice containing several lines.

Use gross correction component from separate source correction and service-credit totals for the correction comparison; net service-credit component never changes the approved corrected billing target.



### Approved correction evidence

For source subtype correction, the source charge has an approved review with decision incorrect. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, status, decision. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference.

### Measurement basis

All posted credit and debit adjustment events through the current handling time for the exact original source reference. For the exact original charge original source reference, report gross correction component as absolute correction credit amount less debit-adjustment amount, and net service-credit component as absolute pretax net amount of service-credit postings. Keep these two named components separate; tax is included only in gross correction component, and unrelated source charges never enter either component.

### Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical source gross charge is USD 140, its correction credits total USD 20, and its debit adjustments total USD 5. Its corrected comparison base is USD 125. An approved gross target of USD 120 therefore calls for a USD 5 credit; an outage concession does not alter that comparison.

title: Enterprise Support: Lifecycle fee charges
content:
Enterprise Support — Lifecycle fee charges.

## Policy clauses

This fee branch applies only to setup, resumption, termination and returned-payment fee source subtype.

Charge setup fee once for an activated holding, resumption fee per distinct completed restoration, termination fee for on-demand exit, and failed payment fee per completed bank return.

An unexpired commitment exit instead bills the recorded remaining signed commitment liability in USD as its termination liability.

Copy the exact source transition, customer authorization or bank notice reference; do not use a primary meter as fee evidence.

A zero fee is waived without a financial event.

The fee amount is the selected policy amount or recorded signed liability, rounded using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention, then taxed under service tax accounting.

The primary-usage branch of primary usage pricing and its posted primary-meter condition gate apply only to source subtype primary; supplemental charges use the category meter policy.

Already billed source occurrence and fee subtype make repetition read-only.

title: Enterprise Support: Official incident registration
content:
Enterprise Support — Official incident registration.

## Policy clauses

Operations record the closed incident, affected holding, exact incident external reference, official incident closure time, cause, measured duration in hours and availability percentage from the official operational report.

No customer statement substitutes for the report.

Scheduled maintenance, customer changes and upstream-customer events remain visible with their cause code even though outage credit accounting excludes them.

Incident registration itself never creates a credit or changes contract status.

title: Enterprise Support: Invoice source identity
content:
Enterprise Support — Invoice source identity.

## Policy clauses

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

Group service charges by invoice grouping.

Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month.

For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records.

Set invoice issue time to the current handling time.

Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge.

A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge.

The fixed source reference and source subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.



### Unbilled source component evidence

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, meter code, source subtype, distinct price component, period, event type, status. Correlate the action to the same original source reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Provider consumption evidence
content:
Enterprise Support — Provider consumption evidence.

## Policy clauses

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity.

Meters originate in the provider resource export.

Primary meter quantities use usage unit; a meter is positive and a consumption reversal is the negative of the exact erroneous source quantity, capped by the source quantity not already reversed.

Keep original interval, region, configuration and source reference.

billing of actual measured overage overage permits measured quantities above included quantity; no service entitlement is invented by a meter write.

Round measured quantities to meter quantity decimal precision using rounding convention, apply minimum quantity and round positive billable primary quantities upward to a whole meter quantum.

Stopped or suspended service accrues no primary running usage, but real retained storage and other supplemental services remain billable through supplemental consumption entry.

A rejected or cancelled source is not a billable meter.

Repeated exports with the same resource, meter, interval and correction reference are read-only confirmations.



### Export evidence evidence

The authoritative export confirms the resource interval and the measured quantity. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, external reference, inclusive service start, exclusive service end, quantity. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Primary usage pricing
content:
Enterprise Support — Primary usage pricing.

## Policy clauses

This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source subtype; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category-specific meter pricing take priority.

For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval.

This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values.

Use the tier recorded for each source service interval.

Read standard primary unit rate and region factors for primary usage.

Allocate included quantity across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in inclusive service start then original source reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month.

Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged.

Allocate committed quantity in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines.

The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive reservation discounts; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary.

For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in discount priority: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated rate allowed, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from promotion channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard.

The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard primary unit rate before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.

Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive.

Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply service tax accounting.

No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.

Record distinct price component for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity.

Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

For support primary usage, standard primary unit rate and signed negotiated unit rate are USD charged per eligible eligible supported spending in USD, so the negotiated rate is the signed fee fraction.

Apply the category monthly minimum after this quantity calculation.



### Posted primary-meter condition evidence

For source subtype primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source subtype values. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, status, inclusive service start, exclusive service end. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

### Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical quantity component has an approved negotiated rate and an eligible promotion. The negotiated price replaces the standard rate before the regional adjustment; the promotion supplies no additional reduction.

title: Enterprise Support: Original-payment cash refunds
content:
Enterprise Support — Original-payment cash refunds.

## Policy clauses

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment.

The customer files an exact refund authorization; the agent refunds a confirmed overpayment only to the method and destination of its original payment.

Available refund is the smaller of the negative net receivable magnitude and original payment principal less prior returns and refunds linked to that payment.

A requested amount exceeding that limit is refused, not silently reduced.

Use refund methods, require at least minimum voluntary cash refund, and record a positive receivable delta for cash paid out.

A smaller positive balance remains on account.

Refunds require no active service contract and remain possible after closure.

Repetition of the same request and source payment returns the existing refund.

A third-party destination or unconfirmed payment is refused.



### Refund consent evidence

The customer-authorized refund request and completed original payment refer to the same holding and source payment. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, request reference, original source reference, status, support contract reference. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, request reference, original source reference, support contract reference.

### Hypothetical case

Suppose a hypothetical negative receivable has magnitude USD 70 and remaining original payment principal is USD 45. The available limit is USD 45. A USD 50 request is refused rather than reduced to that limit.

title: Enterprise Support: Customer request registration
content:
Enterprise Support — Customer request registration.

## Policy clauses

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source reference.

Set recorded notice time and recorded occurrence time to the current handling time and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

An unsupported channel is refused.

A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event.

Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

title: Enterprise Support: Returned payment principal
content:
Enterprise Support — Returned payment principal.

## Policy clauses

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment.

The bank return must identify the exact posted payment.

Restore the returned principal as a positive amount, up to the original payment amount not already returned.

Copy its method, customer, billing entity and currency.

A partial return uses the distinct bank notice external reference.

A duplicate bank notice produces no new write.

Any failed payment fee is a separately identifiable return-fee charge under lifecycle fee accounting, never hidden in returned principal; a waived fee produces no fee posting.



### Bank return evidence

The completed bank return notice refers to the exact original posted payment. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, status, external reference. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, original source reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Accountant source reviews
content:
Enterprise Support — Accountant source reviews.

## Policy clauses

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object.

A service accountant reviews one precise source event against its authoritative export, contract terms, bank notice, tax record or incident record.

Record decision correct or incorrect for a billing review, and eligible or ineligible for an outage claim; status approved means the review is complete and authoritative, not that a credit necessarily follows.

Record corrected pretax net amount and signed tax amount for incorrect billing, or approved credit amount for an eligible outage after applying outage credit accounting.

A rejected review cannot authorize money movement.

The customer may provide a locator but cannot dictate an official decision.

Repeating the same source and request review returns the existing decision; materially new evidence is a distinct review linked through related evidence reference.

Review alone books no money.



### Reviewable source evidence

The source event and the evidence record identify the same holding and narrowest business object. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, support contract reference. Correlate the action to the same support event reference, original source reference, related evidence reference, support contract reference.

title: Enterprise Support: Outage claim credits
content:
Enterprise Support — Outage claim credits.

## Policy clauses

For an outage service credit financial posting, an approved review has decision eligible and positive approved credit amount for the exact source charge; this gate does not constrain filing or reviewing the request.

For an outage service credit request being filed, the outage claim is filed no later than credit claim days after the official incident closes.

For a newly filed claim, current handling time is its recorded notice time; the request is recorded immediately.

Later review and credit use that recorded notice time to evaluate the same boundary, so a timely request does not expire while awaiting review.

Add credit claim days UTC calendar dates to official incident closure time, preserving its time of day; calendar dates are counted without substituting business days or elapsed-hour periods.

Equality at the deadline qualifies; a later claim is rejected without a credit.

The provider incident must be completed, with cause outside outage exclusions.

Availability at or above availability target percentage gives no credit.

Below the target choose the first descending availability credit bands entry whose minimum is no greater than the recorded availability percentage.

Multiply the original source charge pretax net amount by that fraction; subtract the net service-credit component of prior credits for that exact source, and cap total service credits at credit cap fraction of that original net amount.

Floor the additional credit at zero and round with monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

## Policy clauses

The contract status is active.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued.

The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal.

Add invoice due days and then suspension grace days UTC calendar dates to invoice issue time, preserving its time of day; do not use business days or replace the anchor with contract activation.

Equality qualifies.

The source overdue invoice must retain a positive unpaid principal; a fully paid invoice cannot justify suspension.

Earlier handling sends an informational explanation without a status change.

An agent suspends active service only when official payment restriction status is restricted; ordinary billing disputes alone do not suspend service.

Retained ancillary resources can still produce actual supplemental usage.

Repeated handling of an already suspended contract makes no new transition.

The contract status is active. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, status. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference.

Collection suspension occurs no earlier than invoice due days plus suspension grace days after the source invoice is issued. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support event reference, invoice issue time. Correlate the action to the same support event reference.

### Collection restriction evidence

The contract payment restriction status is restricted and the source invoice retains unpaid principal. The authoritative system record must establish the condition before the action. Its evidence comprises support contract reference, payment restriction status, support event reference, amount. Correlate the action to the same support contract reference, support event reference.

### Hypothetical case

For a hypothetical unpaid source invoice, handling exactly at its issue time advanced by the prescribed maturity and grace calendar dates satisfies the time gate.
